name: TS_0074 & TS_0075 - Industry Pages - Agriculture Content and Breadcrumb Back to Buyers

steps.name: Given the user opens the ExportersIndia Buyers page
When the user opens the industry "Agricultural Products & Equipment"
Then the industry page should be displayed at "/buyers/agriculture.htm" with the heading "Buyers for Agricultural Products & Equipment"

And the industry page should list the agriculture categories "Bird, Poultry & Animal Feed; Seeds & Plant Saplings; Fresh Flowers & Plants; Fertilizers & Soil Additives; Pets & Farm Animals; Coir & Agro Products; Farming Tools, Equipment & Machines; Tractors & Tractor Parts; Agricultural Irrigation & Harvesting Equipment; Pesticides & Insecticides" with counts
And at least 10 category headings with counts should be displayed
When the user returns to the Buyers page using the breadcrumb
Then the Buyers page should be displayed
When the user opens the industry "Textiles, Yarn & Fabrics"
Then the industry page URL should contain "/buyers/textiles.htm"
When the user returns to the Buyers page using the breadcrumb
Then the Buyers page should be displayed
